/* service='personhog-identity', operation='delete_unmap_record_moved' */ 
            UPDATE lifecycle_op_person_tmp lop
            SET moved = u.moved
            FROM unnest($2::bigint[], $3::jsonb[]) AS u(person_id, moved)
            WHERE lop.op_id = $1 AND lop.person_id = u.person_id
